item.title: V.Group buys fuel efficiency platform created by Maersk Tankers
item.description: V.Group has bought Njord, the maritime fuel efficiency and decarbonisation platform founded by Maersk Tankers, for an undisclosed sum. Njord will continue to operate under its own brand and will become part of V.’s wider portfolio of service offerings in V.Services. item.title: Union Bulk CEO Bonderup steps down
